hindi: पृथ्वी के लाभ और पालन में पूर्व आचार्यों द्वारा जितने अर्थशास्त्र प्रस्थापित किए गए, प्रायः उन्हें एकत्र करके यह एक अर्थशास्त्र बनाया गया।
english: As many treatises on wealth as were set forth by earlier teachers in the gain and protection of the earth, for the most part having brought those together, this one treatise on wealth was made.
notes: pṛthivyā is printed without visarga (an old genitive form in -ā, or pṛthivyāḥ); read as genitive 'of the earth', governed by lābhe and pālane. The locatives lābhe pālane are rendered 'for the gain and protection' (purpose); literally 'in the gain and protection'. artha in artha-śāstra is wealth (alternatively 'the earth' in the commentators' reading, not applied). prasthāpita is from caus. pra-√sthā 'caused to be set forth'; 'composed' is an alternative. ekam idam can be read 'this one' or 'one, this'. Printed 'saṃhṛtya-ekam' is the e-text's unsandhied join. Reviewer: the locatives are rendered literally 'in the gain and protection'; the purpose reading ('for') is only an alternative.
lines_deva: पृथिव्या लाभे पालने च यावन्त्य् अर्थ.शास्त्राणि पूर्व.आचार्यैः प्रस्थापितानि प्रायशस् तानि संहृत्य-एकम् इदम् अर्थ.शास्त्रं कृतम्
lines_iast: pṛthivyā lābhe pālane ca yāvanty artha.śāstrāṇi pūrva.ācāryaiḥ prasthāpitāni prāyaśas tāni saṃhṛtya-ekam idam artha.śāstraṃ kṛtam

hindi: विद्याओं का समुद्देश, वृद्धों का समुद्देश, इन्द्रिय-जय, अमात्य की उत्पत्ति, मन्त्री और पुरोहित की उत्पत्ति, उपधाओं से अमात्यों की शुचिता और अशुचिता का ज्ञान, गूढ़ पुरुषों की प्रणिधि, अपने देश में कृत्य और अकृत्य पक्ष की रक्षा, दूसरे के देश में कृत्य और अकृत्य पक्ष को सहारा देना, मन्त्र-अधिकार, दूतों की प्रणिधि, राजपुत्र की रक्षा, निकाले गए राजकुमार का वृत्त, निकाले गए राजकुमार के प्रति वृत्ति, राजा की दिनचर्या, निवास की प्रणिधि, स्वयं की रक्षा, यह विनय-अधिकारिक प्रथम अधिकरण है।
english: Enumeration of the sciences; enumeration of the elders; conquest of the senses; origin of the minister; origin of the counsellor and chaplain; knowledge of the purity and impurity of the ministers by means of upadhās; deployment of secret agents; protection of the party of the seducible and the unseducible in one's own territory; support of the party of the seducible and the unseducible in another's territory; section on counsel; deployment of envoys; protection of the king's son; conduct of the prince in disfavour; conduct towards the prince in disfavour; the king's routine; deployment in the residence; protection of oneself. Such is the first section, [that] concerned with discipline.
notes: A table of contents: each comma-separated item is a nominative compound heading of Book 1 (chapters 2-21), the list closing with the section label. praṇidhi is rendered 'deployment' (literally 'placing forth'); rāja-praṇidhi follows the glossary ('the king's routine'). upadhā is kept untranslated (commentators: tests of honesty; not applied). vṛddha-samuddeśa: vṛddha = elders (the older advisers); not expanded. aparuddha: glossary rendering 'prince in disfavour'; the literal sense is 'confined / restrained'; vṛtta = conduct, vṛtti = behaviour (towards, locative). niśānta lit. 'end of night', here 'residence' (house); alternative 'palace'. ātma-rakṣitaka: the -ka form is obscure, rendered 'protection of oneself'. The lone '-' at the end of lines 1 and 2 is the e-text's continuation mark; the '-' before iti is a dash. The viṣaya = territory (Hindi देश).
lines_deva: विद्या.समुद्देशः, वृद्ध.समुद्देशः, इन्द्रिय.जयः, अमात्य.उत्पत्तिः, मन्त्रि.पुरोहित.उत्पत्तिः, उपधाभिः शौच.अशौच.ज्ञानम् अमात्यानाम्, -
गूढ.पुरुष.प्रणिधिः, स्व.विषये कृत्य.अकृत्य.पक्ष.रक्षणम्, पर.विषये कृत्य.अकृत्य.पक्ष.उपग्रहः, -
मन्त्र.अधिकारः, दूत.प्रणिधिः, राज.पुत्र.रक्षणम्, अपरुद्ध.वृत्तम्, अपरुद्धे वृत्तिः, राज.प्रणिधिः, निशान्त.प्रणिधिः, आत्म.रक्षितकम् - इति विनय.अधिकारिकं प्रथमम् अधिकरणम्

hindi: जनपद की बसावट, भूमि के छिद्रों को ढकना, दुर्ग का विधान, दुर्ग की बसावट, सन्निधाता का संचय-कर्म, समाहर्ता का समुदय-प्रस्थापन, अक्ष-पटल में गणना-अधिकार, युक्तों द्वारा अपहृत समुदय को वापस लाना, उपयुक्तों की परीक्षा, शासन-अधिकार, कोश में प्रवेश कराए जाने योग्य रत्नों की परीक्षा, आकर और कर्मान्त का प्रवर्तन, अक्ष-शाला में सोने का अध्यक्ष, गली में सुनार का संचालन, कोष्ठागार का अध्यक्ष, पण्य का अध्यक्ष, कुप्य का अध्यक्ष, आयुध का अध्यक्ष, तुला, माप, पौतव, देश और काल का माप, शुल्क का अध्यक्ष, सूत्र का अध्यक्ष, कूँड़ का अध्यक्ष, सुरा का अध्यक्ष, वधस्थान का अध्यक्ष, गणिका का अध्यक्ष, नौका का अध्यक्ष, गाय-बैल का अध्यक्ष, घोड़े का अध्यक्ष, हाथी का अध्यक्ष, रथ का अध्यक्ष, पैदल सैनिक का अध्यक्ष, सेनापति का संचालन, मुद्रा का अध्यक्ष, चरागाह का अध्यक्ष, समाहर्ता का संचालन, गृहपतिक, वैदेहक, तापस के वेश वाली प्रणिधियाँ, नागरिक की प्रणिधि, यह अध्यक्षों का संचालन द्वितीय अधिकरण है।
english: Settlement of the country; closing of the gaps of the land; arrangement of the fort; settlement of the fort; the Treasurer's work of accumulation; the Collector's setting forth of the revenue; in the akṣa-paṭala, the section on reckoning; bringing back of the revenue carried off by the yuktas; examination of the upayuktas; section on edicts; examination of gems to be taken into the treasury; setting in motion of mines and karmāntas; in the akṣa-śālā, the superintendent of gold; in the street, the operation of the goldsmith; superintendent of the storehouse; superintendent of wares; superintendent of raw materials; superintendent of weapons; tulā, measure and pautava; measure of place and time; superintendent of śulka; superintendent of thread; superintendent of the furrow; superintendent of liquor; superintendent of the slaughter-house; superintendent of courtesans; superintendent of ships; superintendent of cattle; superintendent of horses; superintendent of elephants; superintendent of chariots; superintendent of foot-soldiers; operation of the commander of the army; superintendent of the pass; superintendent of pastures; operation of the Collector; deployments in the guise of householder, trader and ascetic; deployment of the nāgarika. Such is the operation of the superintendents, the second section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 2. Doubtful or obscure items rendered literally: bhūmi-chidra-apidhāna 'closing of the gaps of the land' (commentators: use of waste land; not applied); niveśa 'settlement'; samudaya-prasthāpana 'setting forth of the revenue' (sense 'collection' not stated); akṣa-paṭala, akṣa-śālā, pautava, śulka, nāgarika kept as terms (as in the glossary for 4.9, 4.2, 4.6); ākara-karma-anta read as a dvandva 'mines and karmāntas' (karmānta lit. 'end of work', workshop / works; alternative: one compound 'mine-works'); upayukta, yukta = appointed officers (lit. 'employed'), kept; gāṇanikya = relating to reckoning; sīta here 'furrow' (alternative: agriculture); sūna 'slaughter-house'; mudrā 'pass' (glossary 10.1; alternative 'seal'); viśikhā 'street'; tulā-māna-pautava read as a dvandva of three. pracāra is rendered 'operation' (Hindi संचालन); alternative 'conduct'. In the last line gṛha-patika-vaidehaka-tāpasa-vyañjana is a bahuvrīhi 'having the guise of ...' qualifying praṇidhayaḥ; the Hindi list takes commas only. nāv.adhyakṣa is nau-adhyakṣa; hasty., patty. are hasti-, patti- before a vowel. The lone '-' at line ends is the e-text's continuation mark; the '-' before ity is a dash.

hindi: व्यवहार की स्थापना, विवाद के पदों का निबन्धन, विवाह से जुड़ा, दाय का विभाग, वास्तु-सम्बन्धी, समझौते का अनपाकर्म, ऋण न देना, उपनिधि-सम्बन्धी, दास और कर्मकरों का कल्प, मिलकर उठ खड़ा होना, बेचे और खरीदे हुए का अनुशय, दिए हुए का अनपाकर्म, अस्वामी द्वारा बिक्री, स्व और स्वामी का सम्बन्ध, साहस, वाक्-पारुष्य, दण्ड-पारुष्य, द्यूत और समाह्वय, प्रकीर्णक, यह धर्मस्थ-सम्बन्धी तृतीय अधिकरण है।
english: Establishment of transactions; binding of the grounds of dispute; [that] connected with marriage; division of inheritance; [that] relating to the site; anapākarma of agreement; non-giving of the debt; [that] relating to upanidhi; rule for slaves and workers; having come together, the rising up; anuśaya of the sold and the bought; anapākarma of the given; sale by a non-master; relation of property and master; rashness; verbal injury; physical injury; gambling and samāhvaya; miscellany. Such is the third section, [that] relating to the dharmasthas.
notes: Table of contents of Book 3. Terms kept per the glossary: anapākarma, upanidhi, anuśaya, samāhvaya, dharmastha. vivāda-pada-nibandha: pada 'ground' (alternatives 'title / step'), nibandha lit. 'binding' (compilation); medium. sva-svāmi-sambandha: sva read as 'own (property)'; svāmin = master; alternative 'ownership'. asvāmi-vikraya: 'sale by a non-owner' (svāmin = master); the genitive-style tat-puruṣa could be 'sale of a non-owner'. dyūta-samāhvaya read as a dvandva (alternative: samāhvaya as a kind of dyūta). vāk-pāruṣya / daṇḍa-pāruṣya follow the Book 3 renderings (verbal / physical injury). sambhūya samutthānam 'having come together, the rising up'. vāstuka, aupanidhika: the -ka adjectives are rendered 'relating to'. The e-text prints 'iti,' with a comma.

hindi: कारुओं की रक्षा, वैदेहकों की रक्षा, उपनिपात का प्रतिकार, छिपी जीविका वालों की रक्षा, सिद्ध के वेश वाले गुप्तचरों द्वारा युवकों को प्रकट करना, शंका, वस्तु, कर्म के आधार पर पकड़, अचानक मरे व्यक्ति की परीक्षा, वाक्य और कर्म से पूछताछ, सभी अधिकरणों की रक्षा, एक अंग के नाश का निष्क्रय, शुद्ध और विविध प्रकार का दण्ड-कल्प, कन्या का प्रकर्म, अतिचार के दण्ड, यह कण्टकशोधन चतुर्थ अधिकरण है।
english: Protection of artisans; protection of traders; remedy for mishaps; protection of those with concealed livelihood; revealing of young men by agents in the guise of holy men; seizure by suspicion, object and act; examination of one who died suddenly; questioning by statement and action; protection of all departments; redemption of the destruction of one limb; the plain and the varied rule of penalty; prakarma of a girl; penalties for transgression. Such is the cleansing of thorns, the fourth section.

The lone '-' at the end of lines 1 and 2 is the e-text's continuation mark; the '-' before iti is a dash.

hindi: दाण्डकर्मिक, कोश का अभिसंहरण, भृत्यों का भरण, अनुजीवियों का वृत्त, समय-आचारिक, राज्य को फिर से जोड़ना, एकैश्वर्य, यह योग का वृत्त पञ्चम अधिकरण है।
english: Dāṇḍakarmika; collection of the treasury; the maintaining of servants; conduct of dependants; samaya-ācārika; rejoining of the kingdom; sole sovereignty. Such is the conduct of secret contrivance (yoga), the fifth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 5. dāṇḍakarmika and samaya-ācārika are kept untranslated (glossary 5.6, 7.15; the latter lit. 'of agreed conduct'). kośa-abhisaṃharaṇa 'collection of the treasury' (kośa genitive-like). bhṛtya-bharaṇīya is a gerundive used as a noun: 'what is to be maintained regarding servants'. anujīvin 'dependant' (lit. one living after / on another). rājya-pratisandhāna 'rejoining of the kingdom' is literal and uncertain. yoga-vṛtta: yoga given as 'secret contrivance' (glossary 5.6); the alternative 'acquisition' (6.2) is possible; low certainty.
lines_deva: दाण्डकर्मिकम्, कोश.अभिसंहरणम्, भृत्य.भरणीयम्, अनुजीवि.वृत्तम्, समय.आचारिकम्, राज्य.प्रतिसन्धानम्, एक.ऐश्वर्यम् - इति योग.वृत्तं पञ्चमम् अधिकरणम्

english: Excellences of the constituent elements; [that] relating to peace and activity. Such is the source of the circle, the sixth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 6. yoni lit. 'womb', rendered 'source' per the glossary. śama and vyāyāma as in 6.2 (peace; activity).

hindi: षाड्गुण्य का समुद्देश, क्षय, स्थान, वृद्धि का निश्चय, संश्रय की वृत्ति, समान, हीन, श्रेष्ठ के गुणों का अभिनिवेश, हीन सन्धियाँ, युद्ध करके आसन, सन्धि करके आसन, युद्ध करके यान, सन्धि करके यान, मिलकर प्रयाण, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो और शत्रु के अभिग्रह की चिन्ता, प्रकृतियों के क्षय, लोभ, विरक्ति के कारण, सामवायिक का विपरिमर्श, संहित प्रयाणिक, परिपणित, अपरिपणित, अपसृत सन्धियाँ, द्वैधीभाव सम्बन्धी सन्धि और आक्रमण, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो उसकी वृत्ति, अनुग्रह किए जाने योग्य मित्रों की विशेषताएँ, मित्र, धन, भूमि, कर्म की सन्धियाँ, पार्ष्णिग्राह की चिन्ता, हीन शक्ति की पूर्ति, बलवान् के साथ युद्ध करके उपरोध के कारण, सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाले का वृत्त, सेना को निकट लाने वाले का वृत्त, सन्धि का कर्म, समाधि-मोक्ष, मध्यम का आचरण, उदासीन का आचरण, मण्डल का आचरण, यह षाड्गुण्य सप्तम अधिकरण है।
english: Enumeration of the sixfold policy; determination of decline, stagnation and growth; conduct of shelter; adherence to the guṇas of the equal, the inferior and the superior; inferior treaties; having made war, staying quiet; having made peace, staying quiet; having made war, marching; having made peace, marching; having combined, marching forth; consideration of the seizure of the one to be marched against and the enemy; causes of loss, greed and disaffection of the constituent elements; reflection on the associate (sāmavāyika); allied marching forth; treaties stipulated, unstipulated and gone away; peace and attacks relating to the dual policy; conduct of the one to be marched against; distinctions of allies to be favoured; treaties of ally, money, land and works; consideration of the heel-seizer; filling up of deficient power; causes of obstruction, having made war with the strong; conduct of one submitting with his army; conduct of one who brings the army near; work of peace; release of the samādhi; conduct of the middle king; conduct of the neutral king; conduct of the circle. Such is the sixfold policy, the seventh section.

text_flags.why: possible: missing compound dot / stray space between saṃhita and prayāṇikam

notes: Table of contents of Book 7. Doubtful renderings (literal, medium): saṃśraya-vṛtti 'behaviour of shelter' (alternative: conduct in seeking shelter); guṇa-abhiniveśa 'adherence to the guṇas' (alternative: application); hīna-sandhi read as 'inferior treaties' (a named kind in 7.3; alternative: treaties of the weaker king); abhigraha 'seizure' (alternative: attack, approach); viparimarśa 'reflection'; paripaṇita / aparipaṇita as terms, apasṛta 'gone away' (obscure); dvaidhī-bhāvika 'relating to the dual policy'; uparodha 'obstruction' (alternatives: blockade, siege); upanāyin 'one who brings near' (the object daṇḍa 'army'); samādhi-mokṣa as in 7.17 (alternative 'release of the settlement', 7.17a); sandhi-karma 'work of peace'. In bare sandhi compounds, sandhi = peace; in treaty names = treaty. yātavya.vṛtti could also mean 'behaviour towards'. 'Having combined, marching forth' renders sambhūya prayāṇam. The lone '-' at line ends is the e-text's continuation mark. Reviewer: 'behaviour' in the notes now reads 'conduct' (glossary 1.7); alternatives unchanged.
lines_deva: षाड्गुण्य.समुद्देशः, क्षय.स्थान.वृद्धि.निश्चयः, संश्रय.वृत्तिः, समहीन.ज्यायसां गुण.अभिनिवेशः, हीन.सन्धयः, विगृह्य आसनम्, सन्धाय आसनम्, विगृह्य यानम्, सन्धाय यानम्, -
सम्भूय प्रयाणम्, यातव्य.अमित्रयोर् अभिग्रह.चिन्ता, क्षय.लोभ.विराग.हेतवः प्रकृतीनाम्, सामवायिक.विपरिमर्शः, -
संहित प्रयाणिकम्, परिपणित.अपरिपणित.अपसृताः सन्धयः, द्वैधी.भाविकाः सन्धि.विक्रमाः, यातव्य.वृत्तिः, अनुग्राह्य.मित्र.विशेषाः, -

दण्ड.उपनायि.वृत्तम्, सन्धि.कर्म, समाधि.मोक्षः, मध्यम.चरितम्, उदासीन.चरितम्, मण्डल.चरितम् - इति षाड्गुण्यं सप्तमम् अधिकरणम्

hindi: प्रकृतियों के व्यसनों का वर्ग, राजा और राज्य के व्यसन की चिन्ता, पुरुष के व्यसनों का वर्ग, पीड़न का वर्ग, स्तम्भ का वर्ग, कोश के सङ्ग का वर्ग, मित्र के व्यसनों का वर्ग, यह व्यसन-अधिकारिक अष्टम अधिकरण है।
english: Group of calamities of the constituent elements; consideration of the calamity of the king and the kingdom; group of vices (vyasana) of the person; group of afflictions; group of obstructions; group of impediments of the treasury; group of calamities of the ally. Such is the eighth section, [that] concerned with the topic of calamity.
notes: Table of contents of Book 8. vyasana = calamity for prakṛti, king-and-kingdom and ally, but 'vice' for puruṣa-vyasana (the person's own vices, 8.3), per the glossary. pīḍana = affliction, stambha = obstruction, saṅga = impediment (glossary 8.4). rāja-rājyayoḥ is a dual genitive.

hindi: शक्ति, देश, काल, बल, दुर्बलता का ज्ञान, चढ़ाई के काल, सेना को ग्रहण करने के काल, सन्नाह के गुण, प्रतिबल का कर्म, पीछे के कोप की चिन्ता, बाहरी और भीतरी प्रकृतियों के विद्रोह के प्रतिकार, क्षय, व्यय, लाभ का विपरिमर्श, और बाहरी और भीतरी आपत्तियाँ, दूष्य और शत्रु से जुड़ी, अर्थ, अनर्थ, संशय से युक्त, उनकी उपायों के विकल्प से उत्पन्न सिद्धियाँ, यह चढ़ाई करने वाले का कर्म नवम अधिकरण है।
english: Knowledge of power, place, time, strength and weakness; times of the march; times of taking up troops; qualities of arming (saṃnāha); work of the counterforce; consideration of the later revolt; remedies for uprisings of the external and internal constituent elements; reflection on loss, expenditure and gain; and external and internal adversities, connected with the treasonable and the enemy, joined with gain, loss and doubt; of these, the successes born of alternatives of means. Such is the work of [him who is] about to march against [an enemy], the ninth section.

notes: Table of contents of Book 9. The compound kṣaya.vyaya.lābha.- continues across the line break (the '.-' is the e-text's continuation mark); the first token carries the first members, the second token viparimarśaḥ. The last items run on: 'and the external and internal adversities (āpadaḥ), connected with ..., joined with ...; of these (tāsām) the successes ...'. bala-abala 'strength and weakness'; bala-upādāna 'taking up troops' (glossary 9.2); saṃnāha lit. 'binding on', rendered 'arming' (alternative: preparation, mobilisation); paścāt-kopa 'later revolt' (glossary 9.3); vikalpa 'alternatives'. abhiyāsyat is a future participle, 'about to march against'; the object is not stated.

words.gloss: arraying of the staff, snake, circle and loose arrays

hindi: स्कन्धावार का पड़ाव, स्कन्धावार का प्रयाण, सेना के व्यसन और आक्रमण के समय की रक्षा, कूटयुद्ध के विकल्प, अपनी सेना को उभारना, अपने बल और दूसरे के बल का व्यायोग, युद्ध की भूमियाँ, पैदल, घोड़े, रथ, हाथी के कर्म, पक्षों, कक्षों, उरस्यों का सेना के आगे से व्यूह का विभाग, सार और दुर्बल बल का विभाग, पैदल, घोड़े, रथ, हाथी के युद्ध, दण्ड, भोग, मण्डल, असंहत व्यूह का व्यूहन, उसके प्रतिव्यूह की स्थापना, यह संग्राम-सम्बन्धी दशम अधिकरण है।
english: Encampment of the camp; marching forth of the camp; protection at the time of calamity of the army and assault; alternatives of treacherous warfare; rousing of one's own army; vyāyoga of one's own army and another's army; battle-grounds; actions of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants; division of the array of wings, flanks and centres from the front of the army; division of strong and weak force; modes of fighting of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants; arraying of the staff, snake, circle and loose arrays; establishing of the counter-array of that. Such is [that] relating to battle, the tenth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 10. skandhāvāra-niveśa: literally 'encampment of the camp' (the glossary gives skandhāvāra = camp, niveśa = encampment). vyāyoga is rendered 'mixed yoking' after the earlier draft of 10.4 (gava-aśva-vyāyoga); the sense is uncertain (alternatives: separation, combination). bala-agrataḥ 'from the front of the army' is literal; the sense of the whole item is uncertain (medium-low). The array names daṇḍa / bhoga / maṇḍala / asaṃhata follow the glossary (staff / snake / circle / loose array). sāra-phalgu-bala = strong and weak force. karma in patti-...-karma = actions. The Hindi 'सेना' and 'बल' follow the glossary. Reviewer: vyāyoga is kept untranslated (व्यायोग); 'mixed yoking' withdrawn, sense unknown.
lines_deva: स्कन्ध.आवार.निवेशः, स्कन्ध.आवार.प्रयाणम्, बल.व्यसन.अवस्कन्द.काल.रक्षणम्, कूट.युद्ध.विकल्पाः, स्व.सैन्य.उत्साहनम्, स्व.बल.अन्य.बल.व्यायोगः, युद्ध.भूमयः, पत्त्य्.अश्व.रथ.हस्ति.कर्माणि, पक्ष.कक्ष.उरस्यानां बल.अग्रतो व्यूह.विभागः, सार.फल्गु.बल.विभागः, पत्त्य्.अश्व.रथ.हस्ति.युद्धानि, दण्ड.भोग.मण्डल.असंहत.व्यूह.व्यूहनम्, तस्य प्रतिव्यूह.स्थापनम् - इति साङ्ग्रामिकं दशमम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: skandha.āvāra.niveśaḥ, skandha.āvāra.prayāṇam, bala.vyasana.avaskanda.kāla.rakṣaṇam, kūṭa.yuddha.vikalpāḥ, sva.sainya.utsāhanam, sva.bala.anya.bala.vyāyogaḥ, yuddha.bhūmayaḥ, patty.aśva.ratha.hasti.karmāṇi, pakṣa.kakṣa.urasyānāṃ bala.agrato vyūha.vibhāgaḥ, sāra.phalgu.bala.vibhāgaḥ, patty.aśva.ratha.hasti.yuddhāni, daṇḍa.bhoga.maṇḍala.asaṃhata.vyūha.vyūhanam, tasya prativyūha.sthāpanam - iti sāṅgrāmikaṃ daśamam adhikaraṇam

hindi: भेद के ग्रहण, गुप्त दण्ड, यह संघ का वृत्त एकादश अधिकरण है।
english: Takings up of dissension; secret punishments. Such is the conduct of the saṅgha, the eleventh section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 11. upādāna lit. 'taking up' (alternative sense: means, instrument); bheda = dissension; saṅgha kept (glossary 11.1); upāṃśu-daṇḍa = secret punishment (glossary 13.5).
lines_deva: भेद.उपादानानि, उपांशु.दण्डाः - इति सङ्घ.वृत्तम् एकादशम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: bheda.upādānāni, upāṃśu.daṇḍāḥ - iti saṅgha.vṛttam ekādaśam adhikaraṇam

words.gloss: killing of the chief of the army
deployments of weapon, fire and poison
words.gram: tat-puruṣa, over dvandva, m. nom. pl.

words.gloss: killing of the supply line, reinforcements and foraging force
words.gram: tat-puruṣa, over dvandva, m. nom. sg.

hindi: दूत का कर्म, मन्त्रयुद्ध, सेना के मुखिया का वध, मण्डल को प्रोत्साहन देना, शस्त्र, अग्नि, विष की प्रणिधियाँ, रसद, सहायक सेना, प्रसार का वध, योग-अतिसन्धान, दण्ड-अतिसन्धान, एकमात्र विजय, यह आबलीयस द्वादश अधिकरण है।
english: Work of the envoy; war of counsel; killing of the chief of the army; urging on of the circle; deployments of weapon, fire and poison; killing of the supply line, reinforcements and foraging force; outwitting by secret contrivance; outwitting by force; sole victory. Such is the ābalīyasa, the twelfth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 12. rasa in śastra-agni-rasa = poison (glossary). yoga = secret contrivance (Book 12); daṇḍa-atisandhāna 'by force' (daṇḍa as upāya, glossary 12.1); alternative 'by the army'. The relation between the first member and atisandhāna is a bare tat-puruṣa; 'by' is the likeliest reading. vadha = killing (applied also to the supply line, reinforcements and foragers). ābalīyasa kept untranslated (glossary 7.3). eka-vijaya 'sole victory' (alternative: victory of one).
lines_deva: दूत.कर्म, मन्त्र.युद्धम्, सेना.मुख्य.वधः, मण्डल.प्रोत्साहनम्, शस्त्र.अग्नि.रस.प्रणिधयः, वीवध.आसार.प्रसार.वधः, योग.अतिसन्धानम्, दण्ड.अतिसन्धानम्, एक.विजयः - इत्य् आबलीयसं द्वादशम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: dūta.karma, mantra.yuddham, senā.mukhya.vadhaḥ, maṇḍala.protsāhanam, śastra.agni.rasa.praṇidhayaḥ, vīvadha.āsāra.prasāra.vadhaḥ, yoga.atisandhānam, daṇḍa.atisandhānam, eka.vijayaḥ - ity ābalīyasaṃ dvādaśam adhikaraṇam

words.gloss: causing to vomit out by secret contrivance

hindi: उपजाप, योग-वमन कराना, गुप्तचरों की प्रणिधि, घेराबन्दी का कार्य, कुचलना, प्राप्त का प्रशमन, यह दुर्ग के लाभ का उपाय त्रयोदश अधिकरण है।
english: Secret instigation; causing to vomit out [by] secret contrivance; deployment of spies; siege operation; crushing; pacification of what is obtained. Such is the means of acquiring the fort, the thirteenth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 13. vāmana is rendered literally (the sense 'luring out' only in this note); the bracketed [by] marks the supplied relation between yoga and vāmana. lambha = acquisition (glossary 13.5). labdha 'what is obtained' (the object is not stated).
lines_deva: उपजापः, योग.वामनम्, अपसर्प.प्रणिधिः, पर्युपासन.कर्म, अवमर्दः, लब्ध.प्रशमनम् - इति दुर्ग.लम्भ.उपायस् त्रयोदशम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: upajāpaḥ, yoga.vāmanam, apasarpa.praṇidhiḥ, paryupāsana.karma, avamardaḥ, labdha.praśamanam - iti durga.lambha.upāyas trayodaśam adhikaraṇam

words.gloss: application of the killing of the other's army
remedy for injury to one's own army

hindi: दूसरे की सेना के घात का प्रयोग, धोखा देना, अपनी सेना की क्षति का प्रतिकार, यह औपनिषदिक चतुर्दश अधिकरण है।
english: Application of the killing of the other's army; deceiving; remedy for injury to one's own army. Such is the aupaniṣadika, the fourteenth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 14. para = 'the other' (glossary 9.2); ghāta 'killing'; pralambhana lit. 'deceiving'; aupaniṣadika kept untranslated (glossary 7.15).
lines_deva: पर.बल.घात.प्रयोगः, प्रलम्भनम्, स्व.बल.उपघात.प्रतीकारः - इत्य् औपनिषदिकं चतुर्दशम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: para.bala.ghāta.prayogaḥ, pralambhanam, sva.bala.upaghāta.pratīkāraḥ - ity aupaniṣadikaṃ caturdaśam adhikaraṇam

hindi: तन्त्र की युक्तियाँ, यह तन्त्रयुक्ति पञ्चदश अधिकरण है।
english: The devices of the treatise. Such is the device of the treatise, the fifteenth section.
notes: Table of contents of Book 15. tantra = treatise, yukti = device (glossary 15.1).
lines_deva: तन्त्र.युक्तयः - इति तन्त्र.युक्तिः पञ्चदशम् अधिकरणम्
lines_iast: tantra.yuktayaḥ - iti tantra.yuktiḥ pañcadaśam adhikaraṇam

hindi: शास्त्र का समुद्देश: पन्द्रह अधिकरण, एक सौ अस्सी प्रकरण, एक सौ पचास अध्याय, छह हज़ार श्लोक।
english: The enumeration of the treatise [is]: fifteen sections, one hundred and eighty topics, one hundred and fifty chapters, six thousand ślokas.
notes: sa-aśīti-prakaraṇa-śata is literally 'a hundred topics together with eighty', read as 180; sa-pañcāśat-adhyāya-śata 'a hundred chapters together with fifty', read as 150 (the numbers are an arithmetic reading of the compounds). The closing iti ends the statement and is not rendered. The '-' joins in 'sa-aśīti' and 'sa-pañcāśad' are unsandhied joins inside one compound; each compound has one word entry.
lines_deva: शास्त्र.समुद्देशः पञ्चदश.अधिकरणानि स-अशीति.प्रकरण.शतं स-पञ्चाशद्.अध्याय.शतं षट्.श्लोक.सहस्राणि-इति
lines_iast: śāstra.samuddeśaḥ pañcadaśa.adhikaraṇāni sa-aśīti.prakaraṇa.śataṃ sa-pañcāśad.adhyāya.śataṃ ṣaṭ.śloka.sahasrāṇi-iti

words.gloss: to be understood with easy grasping
settled in principles, meanings and words
words.gram: tat-puruṣa over dvandva, n. nom. sg.

words.gloss: free from the prolixity of texts

hindi: सरल ग्रहण से जानने योग्य, तत्त्व, अर्थ, पद में निश्चित, कौटिल्य द्वारा बनाया गया, ग्रन्थ-विस्तार से विमुक्त शास्त्र।
english: [This is] the treatise, to be understood with easy grasping, settled in principles, meanings and words, made by Kautilya, free from the prolixity of texts.
notes: The sentence is verbless: the two lines are neuter adjectives and nouns (sukha-grahaṇa-vijñeyam, tattva-artha-pada-niścitam, kṛtam, śāstram, vimukta-grantha-vistaram) and 'This is' is supplied. sukha-grahaṇa-vijñeya could also be read 'easy to grasp and to be understood' (alternative); tattva-artha-pada: principles, meanings, words; vimukta-grantha-vistara lit. 'released from the expansion of texts'.
lines_deva: सुख.ग्रहण.विज्ञेयं तत्त्व.अर्थ.पद.निश्चितम्
कौटिल्येन कृतं शास्त्रं विमुक्त.ग्रन्थ.विस्तरम्
lines_iast: sukha.grahaṇa.vijñeyaṃ tattva.artha.pada.niścitam
kauṭilyena kṛtaṃ śāstraṃ vimukta.grantha.vistaram
